description: This file defines the CreateNew class for the GD image toolkit in Drupal, implementing an image creation operation with support for transparency and various image formats.

classes.name: CreateNew
classes.description: Defines a GD2 image operation to create a new transparent image with specified dimensions and format.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Returns the arguments required for the create_new operation, including width, height, extension, transparent color, and temporary flag.

methods.name: validateArguments
methods.description: Validates the provided arguments, ensuring supported extension, positive dimensions, and valid transparent color.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Creates a new true color image, applies transparency settings based on image type, and updates the toolkit with the new image.
